name: git-diff-timeline
description: Git Diff timeline above the prompt: a clean range slider over any branch's history, read without switching to it. Scroll the mouse wheel over it to move through the commits, press the date under a dot to move the nearer knob there, step ‹ › one commit at a time, or pick From and To by commit message; says how long ago the remote branches were fetched, with a Fetch button; a Branches tab compares two branches; a GitHub-style files view shows each file's diff. Works with any git remote.

position.title: Where Git Diff shows
position.description: band: a strip above the prompt in every git repository; picking a commit opens the files view beside the chat. pane: everything in the side pane, which opens itself.
